hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway

hazards.name: Incomplete sidewalk network
hazards.description: The left side of the street lacks a dedicated, separated sidewalk, requiring pedestrians to walk through parking areas or in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street

hazards.name: Lack of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No street light poles are visible in the immediate vicinity, which may reduce pedestrian safety and visibility during nighttime hours.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the streetscape

hazards.name: Lack of designated crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks visible, forcing pedestrians to cross mid-block without priority or visibility enhancements.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible stretch of the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation or planting strip between the sidewalk and the parked cars/roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Adjacent to the curb

hazards.name: Unmarked midblock crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians may attempt to cross the wide roadway without designated markings or protection over a long residential block.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalks
hazards.description: There are no paved walkways, forcing pedestrians to walk on uneven grass or in the travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the visible block

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The stone wall and thick hedge create a lack of 'eyes on the street', which can reduce the perceived safety and security of pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image behind the sidewalk

hazards.name: Wide straight roadway
hazards.description: The long, straight, and relatively wide pavement design can encourage drivers to exceed residential speed limits.
hazards.location_in_image: Center roadway

hazards.name: Lack of traffic calming
hazards.description: The straight, wide residential street lacks physical measures to discourage speeding in a high-density residential area.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway center

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parking
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street obscures sightlines between drivers and pedestrians who might step into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Both curbsides throughout the midblock section

hazards.name: Lack of Protected Crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs visible, which may lead to unsafe midblock crossings in this residential area.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible roadway stretch

hazards.name: Missing sidewalk on the right side
hazards.description: Pedestrians on the right side of the street have no paved walkway, forcing them onto the grass or into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway along the fence line

hazards.name: Wide unmarked roadway
hazards.description: The lack of center lane markings and the overall width of the street may encourage higher vehicle speeds, increasing risk for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway

hazards.name: Wide Roadway
hazards.description: The wide, straight asphalt roadway without traffic calming measures may encourage vehicle speeds higher than appropriate for a residential area.
hazards.location_in_image: Center roadway

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at potential crossing points to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce the crossing distance across the roadway.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with associated signage, particularly near the bus stop location.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to maintain low vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential street with transit access.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees along the sidewalk to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers at the signalized intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer and Widening
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk and add a planting strip or furniture zone to separate pedestrians from moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Speed Tables
interventions.description: Implement vertical speed control measures like speed tables to physically slow traffic to safer speeds.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve safety and security during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk to at least 5-6 feet to meet modern accessibility standards.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalks on both sides of the street.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with curb extensions to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility at crossing points.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds on this straight stretch of road.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway to eliminate the large patch and provide a smooth, predictable surface for all users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and pedestrian warning signage to provide a safe, designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near potential crossing points to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Marked Sidewalk Across Driveway
interventions.description: Apply high-visibility paint or different paving materials to continue the sidewalk across the driveway, signaling pedestrian priority to drivers.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crosswalks
interventions.description: Provide high-visibility marked crosswalks to designate safe crossing locations for residents.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implement physical traffic calming to ensure vehicles maintain the posted 25 mph speed limit in this residential zone.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implementing speed humps or cushions would help maintain low vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential frontage.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings and appropriate signage to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lights to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during dawn, dusk, and nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Enhance existing street lighting with lower-level fixtures focused on the sidewalk and crossing areas.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential context.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and level the cracked sidewalk sections to ensure a safe and accessible path for all users.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the driveway entrance to minimize the conflict zone and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk completion
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk network to the left side of the street to provide a continuous and safe path for pedestrians on both sides.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Add warning signs to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians and the upcoming crossing.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or lower the height of the hedge to improve visibility and 'eyes on the street' for pedestrian security.

interventions.title: Curb Extension/Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Install a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the parking lane to protect pedestrians from traffic.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility marked crosswalks to designate safe crossing locations.

interventions.title: Raised Driveway Crossing
interventions.description: Reconstruct the driveway entrance as a raised crossing to maintain sidewalk level and force vehicles to slow down when entering.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk on the left and relocate utility poles to the furniture zone to ensure a clear, accessible path of travel.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions / Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions at nearby intersections to prevent parking too close to crossings and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical buffer and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk to provide a designated crossing point between residential buildings.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation from moving traffic.
